$comment: Performance lane (scripts/perf-lane.mjs): operations the lane must not send. Parameter values come from the contract's examples; the lane sends the pack's credential (FUT-10).

exclude.GET /createdb: VN-05: it drops and reseeds the database
exclude.GET /users/v1/_debug: VN-06: it answers with every user's password
exclude.GET /books/v1/{book_title}: VN-09: a book is read only by its owner, and the scan user owns none; the lane sends reads only, so it cannot create one, and the seeded titles are random (VN-14)
